title: RNA-Sequencing of whole blood samples from children with a range of acute febrile illnesses
description: RNA sequencing data were generated from the whole blood of children with a range of acute febrile illnesses. These data were used as the validation cohort for a multiclass diagnostic gene expression signature for the discrimination of 18 infectious and inflammatory diseases which was discovered using publicly available microarray datasets.

samples.title: Sample 1
samples.description: Protocols: Whole blood was collected at the time of recruitment in PAXgene tubes RNA samples were stored at −80 °C until further analysis. After additional DNAse treatment, library preparation at paired end reads was conducted using the Illumina's TruSeq® RNA Sample Preparation Kit; ribosomal and globin RNA depletion
